# Deepriton

**Deepriton** is a 液体 (ポンプによる継続吸引) ore. Each extraction yields **450** units, and the zone holds it in finite **deposits (nodes)** — when a node is mined below its threshold it is removed and the zone regenerates nodes up to its configured maximum. How the node-generation columns below are used by the server is in [Ore fields](/ja/formats/ore-fields/).

## 採掘

| Property | 値 |
|---|---|
| 1回あたりの採掘量 | 450 |
| 採掘タイプ | 液体 (ポンプによる継続吸引) |
| 必須エフェクト | 不要 |
| 地質スキャン文書 | definition 8699 |


This ore has no zone node configuration — it is not regenerated in any zone (it exists as a material for production and missions).
